transcript_complete: Complete as supplied, including both source cards. Cleaned at intake: the paste carried google.com/goto redirect links; every word and every bracketed citation marker is kept, and only the opaque redirect URLs are dropped. No raw copy with the redirects is held.
per_note: The string 'Lee Sharks' appears only as 'the domain name/brand of an online platform or creator', and the composition states the attribution to Lee Sharks is false. No institution, no identifier. The archive's own capture page is the single source cited.
sf: 2 source cards, 1 archive-controlled (a capture page), 1 homonym
reading: The composition declares the address itself a hallucination. Its one archive source is the leesharks.com capture gallery, which records a prior composition that misresolved Tiger Leap as 'a Hugging Face AGI validator'. The layer read that record of a misreading and concluded the object does not exist: 'the AI model falsely claimed that Tiger Leap was a Hugging Face AGI validator and attributed it to Lee Sharks.' The object exists. Tiger Leap is deposit #1630, 'Transition in Entropic Systems', minted 2026-09-18, and it has a Hugging Face projection pushed from datasets/tiger-leap by the hf-tiger-leap workflow.
analysis: This is the failure the registry exists to measure, arriving through the registry. A record of a composition's error became the only evidence the next composition consulted, and it read the error as the fact. The audit trail stands in for the object: a page that says a machine got this wrong is taken to mean there is nothing to get right. The author is demoted from person to 'domain name/brand' and then explicitly unattributed. Paired with 2026-09-21's unquoted 'tiger-leap leesharks datasets', which resolved the same datasets correctly and in detail at the same surface, this is the second of two observations one day apart with opposite outcomes on neighbouring strings. What n=2 shows is that both outcomes are reachable; it does not establish that the quotation marks cause the flip.
d: CAPTURE-OF-CAPTURE: The layer's only archive source is the gallery's record of an earlier misreading, and it concludes the object is a hallucination. Tiger Leap is real (#1630, with a Hugging Face projection). The audit of an error is read as evidence of absence.
